title: Tightness and Error Exponents of SDP with Logarithmically Many Communities
summary: We study a semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation for community recovery when the number of communities grows logarithmically. In the balanced stochastic block model with $n=km$ vertices, we consider the regime $k/\log m\toγ>0$, with edge probabilities $α\log m/m$ within communities and $β\log m/m$ across them, for fixed $α>β>0$. We derive the sharp asymptotic tightness boundary away from critical cases.
